about: The Commonwealth Organization at Arrival Chart (4.45): its sheets in printed order, each with its units. id: <chart>/<sheet>/<counter>. code: the ID code in data/tables/units-cw.json. parent: the unit it is assigned to. group: a heading on the sheet with no counter. toe: TOE Strength Points on arrival, {n} of the unit's own kind, {w, n} of a weapons system (data/tables/weapons-*.json), {code, n} of another ID code; land: how many of them may fire on land. strength: under or over (U@, O@). arrives: D (deployed at the start of the campaign), {turn, stage}, or null. morale: {basic, untrained}, on the sheet or on a unit where it differs. eng: an HQ with engineering capability. garrison: the hex. replaces: the counter it takes the place of; takes_toe: and its TOE. formed: formed in play. standin: not in the charts; a stand-in for a unit a set-up deploys (tools/units/oa.py, STAND_INS), arriving only with it. note: the sheet's note letter. refs: units of another sheet listed on this one, arriving or starting attached. Generated by tools/units/oa.py from the rulebook transcription and its addenda.
